title: The Police Shooting That Rocked Chicago

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些未经排练、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: It took four years for the case to make it to trial.
sentences.zh: 这起案件历时四年才进入审判阶段。

sentences.en: It took less than eight hours for the jury to reach a verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪审团做出裁决却不到八小时。

sentences.en: Monica David on the police shooting that has rocked Chicago.
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡·大卫报道震惊芝加哥的警察枪击案。

sentences.en: Friday, October 12th.
sentences.zh: 10月12日，星期五。

sentences.en: On the night of October 20th of 2014, a truck driver out on the southwest side of Chicago in this industrial area
sentences.zh: 2014年10月20日晚，在芝加哥西南部工业区，一名卡车司机

sentences.en: says he saw a man trying to break into trucks and a lot that he was in.
sentences.zh: 称他看到一名男子试图闯入他所在的卡车和停车场。

sentences.en: So the truck driver calls 911.
sentences.zh: 于是卡车司机拨打了 911。

sentences.en: He said that he thought the man was trying to take radios out of the truck.
sentences.zh: 他说他认为那名男子是想从卡车里拿走收音机。

sentences.en: He hangs up the phone with 911 and then has a confrontation with the man.
sentences.zh: 他挂断了 911 电话，然后与该男子发生了对峙。

sentences.en: The man runs off and the truck driver is waiting for the police to come.
sentences.zh: 男子逃跑了，卡车司机在原地等待警察到来。

sentences.en: Well, that set off a really complicated set of events for the city.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这为这座城市引发了一系列非常复杂的事件。

sentences.en: The police officers come and they talk to the truck driver and they get a description.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到后与卡车司机交谈并获取了体貌描述。

sentences.en: Male who he caught breaking into trucks and stealing radios.
sentences.zh: 是一名被他抓到砸车偷收音机的男子。

sentences.en: Black male in a dark shirt.
sentences.zh: 身穿深色衬衫的黑人男子。

sentences.en: And they head off to look for him.
sentences.zh: 然后他们出发寻找他。

sentences.en: Pretty soon after that, they find the guy and they tell him to stop and take his hands out of his pockets.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，他们找到了这个人，并命令他停下、把手从口袋里拿出来。

sentences.en: He doesn't stop, but he does take his hands out of his pockets.
sentences.zh: 他没有停下，但确实把手从口袋里拿出来了。

sentences.en: And what they see is that he's got a knife.
sentences.zh: 而他们看到的是，他手里拿着一把刀。

sentences.en: They try to get him to drop the knife, but he just keeps on walking.
sentences.zh: 他们试图让他把刀放下，但他只是继续往前走。

sentences.en: Hi, anybody have a taser?
sentences.zh: 喂，有人有电击枪吗？

sentences.en: How about 4-0 and Keeler for 8-15 Robert?
sentences.zh: 4-0 和基勒街的 8-15 罗伯特在吗？

sentences.en: Looking for a taser.
sentences.zh: 寻找电击枪。

sentences.en: When he won't stop and he won't drop the knife, they call for reinforcements.
sentences.zh: 当他不肯停下也不肯放下刀时，他们呼叫了增援。

sentences.en: Hi, Getty, it's 12 coming.
sentences.zh: 喂，盖蒂，12 号正在赶来。

sentences.en: Anyone else closer?
sentences.zh: 还有其他人更近吗？

sentences.en: Asking for a taser for arm defender with a knife.
sentences.zh: 请求支援电击枪，应对持刀武装嫌疑人。

sentences.en: At one point, the police car gets so close.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，警车靠得非常近。

sentences.en: Pumped our tire on the car squad.
sentences.zh: 扎破了我们小队车的轮胎。

sentences.en: Passed.
sentences.zh: 通过。

sentences.en: He manages to slash the tire of one of the squad cars.
sentences.zh: 他设法割破了一辆警车的轮胎。
收到。

sentences.en: Anybody close?
sentences.zh: 有人在附近吗？

sentences.en: Well, by now, more and more police cars are coming on the scene.
sentences.zh: 好了，此时越来越多的警车赶到现场。

sentences.en: Like a dozen officers out there.
sentences.zh: 大概有十几个警员在那里。

sentences.en: Lots of squad cars, lots of lights and sirens.
sentences.zh: 大量的警车，大量的警灯和警笛。

sentences.en: 4-0, they're more bikes.
sentences.zh: 4-0，还有更多骑单车的。

sentences.en: They're just trailing a guy who's walking along the road with a knife.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在尾随一个拿着刀走在路上的家伙。

sentences.en: Let me know when he's in custody, guys.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，他被拘留时告诉我一声。

sentences.en: They go through a parking lot of a Burger King.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过汉堡王的停车场。

sentences.en: Some police cars go one way and some go around a corner a different way.
sentences.zh: 一些警车走一条路，另一些从不同的方向拐过街角。

sentences.en: But in the end, they end up on...
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们来到了……

sentences.en: Walking toward Pulaski from Keeler.
sentences.zh: 从基勒街朝普拉斯基街走去。

sentences.en: Pulaski on this road where it's really just pretty much the police cars and this man walking along with a knife.
sentences.zh: 普拉斯基街这条路上基本上只有警车和这个持刀行走的男子。

sentences.en: So a lot of the police cars had dash cam video running in them that night.
sentences.zh: 所以那天晚上很多警车上都开着行车记录仪视频。

sentences.en: But there's one car right behind this man.
sentences.zh: 但这个男子身后紧跟着一辆警车。

sentences.en: And that video captures everything that happened.
sentences.zh: 那段视频记录了发生的一切。

sentences.en: So what you see is you see the man with the knife moving away from the police officers.
sentences.zh: 你所看到的是，持刀男子正远离警察。

sentences.en: This whole set of police officers that's been following him.
sentences.zh: 这整群一直跟着他的警察。

sentences.en: He keeps walking away just as he has been.
sentences.zh: 他像之前一样继续往前走。

sentences.en: And then you see an SUV, a police SUV, pull up to the side of him.
sentences.zh: 然后你看到一辆 SUV，一辆警用 SUV 开到他旁边。

sentences.en: And you see a police officer, Officer Jason Van Dyke, jump out.
sentences.zh: 你看到一名警察，杰森·范戴克警官跳了出来。

sentences.en: And at that point, you see the man, he veers away from Officer Van Dyke ever so slightly.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，你看到那名男子稍微避开了范戴克警官。

sentences.en: And with that, Officer Jason Van Dyke starts shooting.
sentences.zh: 紧接着，杰森·范戴克警官开始开枪。

sentences.en: And you can, in the video, see the man spin around as he's hit and fall to the ground.
sentences.zh: 你可以在视频中看到男子中弹后旋转着倒在地上。

sentences.en: And the bullets just keep coming.
sentences.zh: 枪声还在继续。

sentences.en: When it's finally over, you see an officer come over and kick the knife away from the man's hand.
sentences.zh: 当这一切终于结束时，你看到一名警察走过来把男子手边的刀踢开。

sentences.en: It turned out that the person on the street wasn't a man.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，街上那个人不是个成年男子。

sentences.en: It was a boy.
sentences.zh: 而是一个男孩。

sentences.en: He had just turned 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 他刚满 17 岁。

sentences.en: His name was Laquan McDonald.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫拉克安·麦克唐纳。

sentences.en: Laquan was someone who had had a difficult young life.
sentences.zh: 拉克安有着一段艰难的童年。

sentences.en: When he was born, his mom was a teenager herself.
sentences.zh: 他出生时，他的母亲自己也还是个青少年。

sentences.en: He ended up in foster care repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 他最终屡次进入寄养系统。

sentences.en: He had been diagnosed with PTSD at a very young age.
sentences.zh: 他在很小的时候就被诊断患有创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）。

sentences.en: He was someone who was in juvenile detention and had his share of probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他曾进过少管所，也有过不少麻烦。

sentences.en: There was a sense, I think, that you find in the court records about him that he was a resilient person.
sentences.zh: 我想，你在关于他的法庭记录中会发现一种看法，即他是一个有韧性的人。

sentences.en: Right before he was shot, his principal said that he was going to school and he was behaving well and, in fact, was even giving some people hugs.
sentences.zh: 就在他被枪杀之前，他的校长说他去上学了，表现很好，事实上甚至还拥抱了一些人。

sentences.en: His mother was trying to regain custody of him at that point.
sentences.zh: 当时他的母亲正试图重新获得他的抚养权。

sentences.en: So there were some signs that things were looking up.
sentences.zh: 所以有一些迹象表明情况正在好转。

sentences.en: So Laquan McDonald's death took place just a few months after the death of Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri, another case of a white police officer shooting a black teen.
sentences.zh: 拉克安·麦克唐纳的死发生在密苏里州弗格森迈克尔·布朗之死几个月后，那是另一起白人警察枪杀黑人青少年的案件。

sentences.en: You would have thought that Laquan McDonald's death would have drawn a ton of attention, but it actually didn't.
sentences.zh: 你本以为拉克安·麦克唐纳的死会引发大量关注，但实际上并没有。

sentences.en: In fact, it drew almost no attention in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它在芝加哥几乎没有引起任何关注。

sentences.en: The reports from police had been that he behaved aggressively, that he maybe lunged at the officer.
sentences.zh: 警方的报告称他表现出攻击性，可能向警察扑过去。

sentences.en: Police say this was a clear-cut case of self-defense.
sentences.zh: 警方表示，这是一起明确的正当防卫案件。

sentences.en: Carrying a three-inch knife, and he apparently ignored officers' orders to stop.
sentences.zh: 携带一把三英寸长的刀，并且显然不理会警察停止的命令。

sentences.en: Police officers say that Laquan McDonald lunged towards Officer Van Dyke.
sentences.zh: 警察称拉克安·麦克唐纳朝范戴克警官冲了过去。

sentences.en: The sense was that the police had behaved in self-defense in this case, and Chicago sort of moved on,
sentences.zh: 人们认为警方在这个案件中是出于自卫，芝加哥也就这么过去了，

sentences.en: except there was somebody inside law enforcement who had seen the dash cam video or knew of the dash cam video and tipped off an independent journalist and said, hey,
sentences.zh: 除了执法部门内部有人看过行车记录仪视频或知道该视频，并向独立记者透露说，嘿，

sentences.en: you have got to see this video.
sentences.zh: 你必须看看这个视频。

sentences.en: It's terrible.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: From there, there was a crescendo of interest in getting a hold of this video.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，获取这段视频的呼声越来越高。

sentences.en: There is a video from one police car that may actually show the clearest angle.
sentences.zh: 有一辆警车的视频可能实际上显示了最清晰的角度。

sentences.en: That has not been released.
sentences.zh: 该视频尚未公开发布。

sentences.en: ...and filed our own freedom of information request with the Chicago Police Department, asking them for any dash cam video.
sentences.zh: ……并向芝加哥警察局提交了我们自己的信息自由法申请，要求提供任何行车记录仪视频。

sentences.en: Those who have seen the video say it is explosive.
sentences.zh: 看过视频的人说它极其震撼。

sentences.en: And freelance journalist Brandon Smith has filed suit to have that video released.
sentences.zh: 自由记者布兰登·史密斯已提起诉讼，要求公布该视频。

sentences.en: The city fought to conceal the video, though, even after the Wall Street Journal, the Chicago Tribune, and a freelance journalist all filed FOIA requests for its release.
sentences.zh: 尽管《华尔街日报》、《芝加哥论坛报》和一名自由记者都根据《信息自由法》提交了公开申请，但市政府仍在极力隐瞒这段视频。

sentences.en: The city said that they couldn't release it because it was part of an ongoing investigation, which was true,
sentences.zh: 市政府表示他们不能公布，因为它是正在进行的调查的一部分，这确实是真的，

sentences.en: but it also meant that the city was able to delay the release through an election.
sentences.zh: 但这也意味着市政府能够通过选举来拖延公布。

sentences.en: As you know, we have charged Chicago Police Officer Jason Van Dyke with first-degree murder in the connection of the shooting death of Laquan Laquan.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我们已指控芝加哥警官杰森·范戴克犯有一级谋杀罪，罪名与枪杀拉克安有关。

sentences.en: The county prosecutor calls a press conference.
sentences.zh: 县检察官召开新闻发布会。

sentences.en: She announces that she's bringing charges against Jason Van Dyke.
sentences.zh: 她宣布对杰森·范戴克提起指控。

sentences.en: With these charges, we are bringing a full measure of justice that this demands.
sentences.zh: 通过这些指控，我们正在带来这一切所需的全面正义。

sentences.en: And there's some skepticism in Chicago about the timing of all this.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥对这一切的时机存在一些怀疑。

sentences.en: Why bring charges now, just before the release of the video?
sentences.zh: 为什么偏偏在视频发布前夕提出指控？

sentences.en: Throughout the course of our investigation, I've seen the video on a number of occasions.
sentences.zh: 在我们调查的过程中，我多次看过这段视频。

sentences.en: And I can tell you, it is graphic, it is violent, it is chilling.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，它是惨烈的、暴力的、令人毛骨悚然的。

sentences.en: And I have absolutely no doubt that this video will tear at the hearts of all Chicagoans.
sentences.zh: 我毫不怀疑这段视频将撕裂所有芝加哥人的心。

sentences.en: And so when the video finally comes out, it had an instantaneous impact on the city.
sentences.zh: 所以当视频最终公之于众时，它对这座城市产生了立竿见影的影响。

sentences.en: Protesters filled the streets of Chicago following the release of a video showing a police officer shooting a black teenager.
sentences.zh: 在一段显示警察枪杀黑人青少年的视频发布后，抗议者挤满了芝加哥的街道。

sentences.en: There are people marching on the streets within a matter of a few hours.
sentences.zh: 短短几个小时内，人们就在街头游行。

sentences.en: They were furious that this hadn't been released sooner.
sentences.zh: 他们对视频没有早点公布感到愤怒。

sentences.en: They were furious that it had happened at all.
sentences.zh: 他们对这种事竟然发生感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Tonight, a second night of protest is underway in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 今晚，芝加哥的第二晚抗议活动正在进行中。

sentences.en: They were furious that there had been so many shots.
sentences.zh: 他们对开了这么多枪感到愤怒。

sentences.en: There was something about the sheer number of shots, 16 shots, that no one could really make sense of.
sentences.zh: 枪击的绝对数量——16枪，让人无法理解。

sentences.en: People felt like the city had been keeping the information from them.
sentences.zh: 人们觉得市政府一直在向他们隐瞒信息。

sentences.en: And there were plenty of people who felt like this was a cover-up.
sentences.zh: 有很多人觉得这是一场掩盖。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载《时报》App，并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: After the dash cam video was released, the fallout was pretty immediate and pretty significant.
sentences.zh: 行车记录仪视频发布后，其引发的余波是相当直接且重大的。

sentences.en: Superintendent McCarthy and I began a discussion on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡局长和我从周日开始进行了讨论。

sentences.en: This morning, I formally asked for his resignation.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我正式要求他辞职。

sentences.en: The police superintendent was fired.
sentences.zh: 警察局长被解雇了。

sentences.en: Kim Fox on seats incumbent Anita Alvarez.
sentences.zh: 金·福克斯击败了在任的安妮塔·阿尔瓦雷斯。

sentences.en: The county prosecutor lost her re-election bid.
sentences.zh: 县检察官竞选连任失败。

sentences.en: The mayor says hundreds of tasers have now been shipped to Chicago.
sentences.zh: 市长表示，数百支电击枪现已运抵芝加哥。

sentences.en: The city expanded the availability of tasers.
sentences.zh: 该市扩大了电击枪的配备范围。

sentences.en: With the police department reeling from some controversial officer-involved fatal shootings, the mayor and his top cop promised change.
sentences.zh: 在警察局因一些引发争议的涉警致命枪击事件而陷入动荡之际，市长和他的顶级警官承诺做出改变。

sentences.en: They started looking at other reforms that could be made about how police use force.
sentences.zh: 他们开始探讨可以对警察使用武力的方式进行哪些其他改革。

sentences.en: We found that the Chicago Police Department engages in a pattern or practice of using excessive force.
sentences.zh: 我们发现芝加哥警察局在过度使用武力方面存在模式或惯例。

sentences.en: It triggered a local task force investigation into the department and a U.S.
sentences.zh: 这引发了当地特别工作组对该部门的调查以及美国

sentences.en: Justice Department investigation.
sentences.zh: 司法部的调查。

sentences.en: And on the basis of this exhaustive review, the Department of Justice has concluded that the Chicago Police Department engages in a pattern or practice of use of excessive force.
sentences.zh: 基于这番详尽的审查，司法部得出结论：芝加哥警察局在过度使用武力方面存在模式或惯例。

sentences.en: And as much as I love this job and will always love this city and its residents, I've decided not to seek the election.
sentences.zh: 尽管我如此热爱这份工作，也将永远热爱这座城市及其居民，但我已决定不再寻求连任。

sentences.en: Rahm Emanuel, the mayor, announced that he would not seek a new term in office.
sentences.zh: 市长拉姆·伊曼纽尔宣布他将不再寻求新任期。

sentences.en: He has said that it wasn't about the Laquan McDonald shooting.
sentences.zh: 他曾表示这与拉克安·麦克唐纳枪击案无关。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of people who would tell you that the dash cam and Laquan McDonald's death left a huge mark on his tenure as mayor.
sentences.zh: 但很多人会告诉你，行车记录仪和拉克安·麦克唐纳的死在他的市长任期内留下了巨大的烙印。

sentences.en: By the time the trial starts in September of 2018, lots of people in Chicago are watching.
sentences.zh: 到 2018 年 9 月审判开始时，芝加哥的许多人在密切关注。

sentences.en: And that's because it's been almost 50 years since a Chicago police officer was convicted of murder in an on-duty shooting.
sentences.zh: 这是因为距离芝加哥警察因执勤时枪击而被判谋杀罪已过去近 50 年。

sentences.en: And in a way, the trial comes to represent not just a trial of one police officer in one shooting, but sort of all of the police shootings that we've had over time.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这场审判不仅是对一名警察在一次枪击事件中的审判，某种程度上也是对我们过去发生的所有警察枪击事件的审判。

sentences.en: And this lingering question about whether police officers will be held accountable for these shootings.
sentences.zh: 以及关于警察是否会为这些枪击事件承担责任的挥之不去的疑问。

sentences.en: It's important to understand that Chicago has a really troubling path.
sentences.zh: 重要的是要明白，芝加哥有一段非常令人不安的历史。

sentences.en: There has been a systematic violation of the human rights of African-Americans who have been subjected to some of the most indignant conduct in any human being convicted upon another.
sentences.zh: 非裔美国人的基本人权受到了系统性的侵犯，他们遭受了一些人类对他人所能施加的最具侮辱性的对待。

sentences.en: Everybody here remembers those stories.
sentences.zh: 这里的每个人都记得那些故事。

sentences.en: And those are the stories in the back of people's minds leading into this trial.
sentences.zh: 而这些故事正是人们在进入这场审判时脑海中挥之不去的背景。

sentences.en: As the trial starts, you see outside the courthouse a level of security that's really unusual.
sentences.zh: 审判开始时，你会看到法院外面有很不寻常的安保级别。

sentences.en: There's a line of police officers every morning waiting outside the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，法院外面都排着一队警察。

sentences.en: There are barricades up, making room for the possibility of protesters.
sentences.zh: 这里设置了路障，为可能出现的抗议者腾出空间。

sentences.en: You can just feel the tension.
sentences.zh: 你简直能感受到那种紧张的气氛。

sentences.en: It feels like something really big is about to happen.
sentences.zh: 感觉有什么大事要发生了。

sentences.en: Madam Sheriff, will you present the decorum order?
sentences.zh: 法警长，请宣读法庭秩序好吗？

sentences.en: There's no talking while court's in session.
sentences.zh: 法庭开庭期间不准交头接耳。

sentences.en: If you want to talk, you need to step outside.
sentences.zh: 如果你想说话，请出去。

sentences.en: So inside the courtroom, you see Jason Van Dyke on one side, sitting alongside his set of lawyers.
sentences.zh: 所以在法庭里面，你可以看到杰森·范·戴克（Jason Van Dyke）坐在一边，他的律师团队坐在他身旁。

sentences.en: Do not approach Mr. Jason Van Dyke for any reason whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 无论出于什么原因，都不要靠近杰森·范·戴克先生。

sentences.en: And then you see another line of lawyers that are the prosecution team.
sentences.zh: 然后你看到另一排律师，那是控方团队。

sentences.en: Would everybody please be seated?
sentences.zh: 请大家就座好吗？

sentences.en: At the bench, you've got Judge Gaughan.
sentences.zh: 在法官席上，坐着高根（Gaughan）法官。

sentences.en: And then on the far side of the room.
sentences.zh: 然后在房间的另一头。

sentences.en: Our wonderful jurors, if the monitor goes off, could you please raise your hand and we'll get it hooked up real quick.
sentences.zh: 我们优秀的陪审员们，如果监视器熄灭了，请举手，我们会马上把它接好。

sentences.en: You have the jury sitting in the jury box.
sentences.zh: 你会看到陪审团坐在陪审团席上。

sentences.en: We're here today because the defendant shot Laquan McDonald 16 times when it was completely unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 我们今天来到这里，是因为被告在完全没有必要的情况下，向拉坎·麦克唐纳（Laquan McDonald）开枪射击了16次。

sentences.en: So the prosecution begins and they're presenting really a pretty straightforward case.
sentences.zh: 因此，控方开始陈述，他们呈现的案情实际上相当直观。

sentences.en: 16 gunshots into the defenseless body of Laquan McDonald.
sentences.zh: 16发子弹射入了拉坎·麦克唐纳毫无防备的身体。

sentences.en: And it's captured on video.
sentences.zh: 这一切都被视频拍了下来。

sentences.en: We're going to see it right now.
sentences.zh: 我们马上就要看到了。

sentences.en: The essence of the prosecution case was the video.
sentences.zh: 控方案子的核心就是这段视频。

sentences.en: They presented other witnesses, of course, but if you had to boil it down into one sentence, that's what it was.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们还出示了其他证人，但如果必须浓缩成一句话，那就是这个。

sentences.en: It was the video.
sentences.zh: 就是这段视频。

sentences.en: When you are working on these cases, the only vantage point that you have is the vantage point of a video.
sentences.zh: 当你处理这些案件时，你唯一的视角就是视频的视角。

sentences.en: But when you recreate everything three-dimensionally, you're no longer stuck in those.
sentences.zh: 但当你进行三维重建时，你就不再局限于那些画面了。

sentences.en: You can now change the views.
sentences.zh: 你现在可以改变视角。

sentences.en: And the defense presented a different, more complicated argument.
sentences.zh: 而辩方提出了一个不同且更复杂的论点。

sentences.en: In this particular situation, we can now put a camera over the shoulder of, in this case, Officer Van Dyke, and we can now watch it from these different perspectives.
sentences.zh: 在这种特殊情况下，我们现在可以把摄像机放在本案中范·戴克警官的肩膀上方，然后我们可以从这些不同的角度来观看。

sentences.en: The defense took the dash cam video and they really turned it on its head.
sentences.zh: 辩方采用了行车记录仪的视频，并将其彻底颠覆。

sentences.en: They said that they used laser-based technology to take everything that had happened there that night and turn it so that you could see what it would have looked like from Officer Van Dyke's point of view.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们利用激光技术，把那天晚上发生的一切都转化了，这样你就能看到从范·戴克警官的角度看过去会是什么样子。

sentences.en: What was Laquan McDonald doing?
sentences.zh: 拉坎·麦克唐纳在做什么？

sentences.en: Advancing on me.
sentences.zh: 向我逼近。

sentences.en: And could you see him, his face?
sentences.zh: 你能看到他吗，他的脸？

sentences.en: Yeah, I could.
sentences.zh: 是的，我能。

sentences.en: His face had no expression.
sentences.zh: 他的脸上没有任何表情。

sentences.en: His eyes were just bugging out of his head.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛都快从眼眶里凸出来了。

sentences.en: He had just these huge white eyes just staring right through me.
sentences.zh: 他那双巨大的白眼睛直勾勾地盯着我。

sentences.en: I was yelling at him, drop the knife.
sentences.zh: 我向他大喊，把刀放下。

sentences.en: I yelled at him, I don't know how many times, but that's all I yelled.
sentences.zh: 我向他大喊，我不知道喊了多少次，但我喊的只有这个。

sentences.en: And did he keep advancing toward you?
sentences.zh: 他还在继续向你逼近吗？

sentences.en: He never stopped.
sentences.zh: 他从未停下。

sentences.en: They were sort of putting up the dash cam video against the animation they created and almost making them equal.
sentences.zh: 他们有点把行车记录仪视频和他们制作的动画进行对比，几乎把它们放在了同等的位置。

sentences.en: His own animation shows a murder and five counts of aggravated battery with a firearm.
sentences.zh: 他自己的动画显示了一起谋杀案和五项持枪严重伤害罪。

sentences.en: When it came down to closing arguments, there was one impassioned argument that did stand out.
sentences.zh: 到了结案陈词的时候，有一个慷慨激昂的辩论确实脱颖而出。

sentences.en: Laquan McDonald wasn't trying to attack anyone that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，拉坎·麦克唐纳并没有试图袭击任何人。

sentences.en: The prosecutor stood up and essentially laid out what he saw as the scenario.
sentences.zh: 检察官站起来，基本上阐述了他所看到的场景。

sentences.en: He was demonstrating his intent and his desire to avoid confrontation at every stage.
sentences.zh: 他在各个阶段都表现出自己的意图和愿望，想要避免对抗。

sentences.en: Where Laquan McDonald had at every turn tried to basically get out of there.
sentences.zh: 拉坎·麦克唐纳在每一个转折点都基本上试图离开那里。

sentences.en: It's Jason Van Dyke firing bullets, ripping into the flesh of Laquan McDonald 16 times.
sentences.zh: 是杰森·范·戴克开枪射击，16次子弹撕裂了拉坎·麦克唐纳的血肉。

sentences.en: That's not justified.
sentences.zh: 这是不公正的。

sentences.en: That's not necessary.
sentences.zh: 这是不必要的。

sentences.en: That's first degree murder.
sentences.zh: 这是谋杀罪。

sentences.en: So the jury went off to deliberate on Thursday afternoon and they came back in the morning.
sentences.zh: 于是陪审团在周四下午去进行商议，并在早上回来了。

sentences.en: Has the jury reached verdicts?
sentences.zh: 陪审团达成裁决了吗？

sentences.en: Will you please read the verdicts?
sentences.zh: 请宣读裁决好吗？

sentences.en: When the jury came back, it did feel like there had been this video where bullet after bullet after bullet after bullet after bullet.
sentences.zh: 当陪审团回来时，确实让人感觉好像有这样一段视频，里面子弹一颗接一颗地射出。

sentences.en: Hit Laquan McDonald, 16 shots in all.
sentences.zh: 击中拉坎·麦克唐纳，总共16枪。

sentences.en: And there's the jury reading out guilty of aggravated battery with a firearm on count one.
sentences.zh: 陪审团正在宣读第一项指控持枪严重伤害罪成立。

sentences.en: Guilty of aggravated battery with a firearm on count two.
sentences.zh: 第二项指控持枪严重伤害罪成立。

sentences.en: And on and on and on through 16 shots.
sentences.zh: 就这样伴随着16枪一直持续下去。

sentences.en: Reading jury find the defendant, Jason Van Dyke, guilty of aggravated battery with a firearm on count two.
sentences.zh: 宣读陪审团裁定被告杰森·范·戴克在第二项指控上的持枪严重伤害罪成立。

sentences.en: One for every single bullet.
sentences.zh: 每一颗子弹对应一项。

sentences.en: Now Jason Van Dyke is in jail.
sentences.zh: 现在杰森·范·戴克在监狱里。

sentences.en: He's awaiting sentencing, which will come presumably relatively soon.
sentences.zh: 他在等待量刑，预计很快就会宣判。

sentences.en: But there's another trial that Chicago is going to be watching for.
sentences.zh: 但芝加哥还将关注另一场审判。

sentences.en: And it's three police officers who were involved that night who are charged with lying about what happened.
sentences.zh: 那是三名当晚涉案的警察，他们被指控对所发生的事情撒谎。

sentences.en: The story that these officers told and the picture that they put together was the one that was sort of the official police version of what happened.
sentences.zh: 这些警察讲述的故事和他们拼凑的画面，某种程度上是关于所发生事情的官方警察版本。

sentences.en: They described a situation where Officer Van Dyke had reason to be in fear for his life.
sentences.zh: 他们描述了一种情况，即范·戴克警官有理由为自己的生命安全感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And in fact, one of the officers got up on the stand at Officer Van Dyke's trial and told that story again, described this aggressive movement and a case for self-defense.
sentences.zh: 事实上，其中一名警察在范·戴克警官的审判中出庭作证，再次讲述了那个故事，描述了这种激进的动作以及正当防卫的理由。

sentences.en: So I think that the outcome of this trial was really important to some people here,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这场审判的结果对这里的某些人来说非常重要，

sentences.en: people who had thought that no police officer would ever be held accountable for a police shooting.
sentences.zh: 那些原本认为绝不会有警察为警察枪击事件承担责任的人。

sentences.en: And so for those people, this has gone a long way.
sentences.zh: 所以对这些人来说，这具有深远的意义。

sentences.en: But now there's a bigger question about how far accountability will go.
sentences.zh: 但现在有一个更大的问题，即追究责任的力度会有多大。

sentences.en: Will it stop with a police officer who does the shooting?
sentences.zh: 它会止步于开枪的警察吗？

sentences.en: Or will it go on to all the fellow officers who have to report what they saw?
sentences.zh: 还是会追究所有必须报告所见所闻的同僚警察？

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的事情。

sentences.en: This morning, Florida's Gulf Coast, Panhandle, and Big Ben are waking up to unimaginable destruction.
sentences.zh: 今天早晨，佛罗里达州的墨西哥湾沿岸、狭长地带和大本德地区正在醒来，迎面而来的是难以想象的破坏。

sentences.en: Across northern Florida on Thursday, search and rescue teams raced to reach communities overwhelmed by Hurricane Michael, a Category 4 storm whose intensity wiped out entire towns.
sentences.zh: 周四，在整个佛罗里达北部，搜救团队争分夺秒地赶往被迈克尔飓风摧毁的社区，这是一场4级风暴，其强度抹去了整座整座的城镇。

sentences.en: So many lives have been changed forever.
sentences.zh: 无数人的生活被永远改变了。

sentences.en: So many families have lost everything.
sentences.zh: 无数的家庭失去了所有的一切。

sentences.en: Homes are gone.
sentences.zh: 房屋消失了。

sentences.en: Businesses are gone.
sentences.zh: 企业消失了。

sentences.en: Roads and infrastructure along the storm's path have been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 风暴路径沿线的道路和基础设施都被摧毁了。

sentences.en: This hurricane was an absolute monster.
sentences.zh: 这场飓风绝对是个庞然大物。

sentences.en: And the damage left in its wake is still yet to be fully understood.
sentences.zh: 它留下的破坏仍有待充分了解。

sentences.en: The hurricane killed at least six people, damaged thousands of homes, and cut off electricity to more than one million residents.
sentences.zh: 飓风造成至少6人死亡，数千栋房屋受损，并切断了100多万居民的电力供应。

sentences.en: Help is coming by air, land, and sea.
sentences.zh: 救援物资正通过空中、陆地和水路运送过来。

sentences.en: This is a very dense part of the state.
sentences.zh: 这是该州人口非常稠密的地区。

sentences.en: And so it's going to be a lot of work to get to everybody, but we will get to everybody.
sentences.zh: 因此，要接触到每一个人将会有大量的工作要做，但我们会接触到每一个人。

sentences.en: Michael, downgraded to a tropical storm, is now moving across the Carolinas and is expected to drift out to sea this morning.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔已降级为热带风暴，目前正在穿过卡罗莱纳州，预计将于今天早晨移入海洋。

sentences.en: The Daily is produced by Theo Balcom, Lindsay Garrison, Rachel Quester, Annie Brown, Andy Mills, Ike Sreeskan-Laraja, Claire Tennesketter, Paige Cowett, Michael Simon-Johnson,
sentences.zh: 本期《每日新闻》由西奥·巴尔科姆（Theo Balcom）、林赛·加里森（Lindsay Garrison）、雷切尔·克斯特（Rachel Quester）、安妮·布朗（Annie Brown）、安迪·米尔斯（Andy Mills）、艾克·斯里施坎-拉拉哈（Ike Sreeskan-Laraja）、克莱尔·特内斯凯特（Claire Tennesketter）、佩奇·考维特（Paige Cowett）、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊（Michael Simon-Johnson）制作，

sentences.en: Jessica Chung, Alexandra Lee Young, and Nina Potok.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·钟（Jessica Chung）、亚历山德拉·李·杨（Alexandra Lee Young）和尼娜·波托克（Nina Potok）。

sentences.en: With editing help from Larissa Anderson and Wendy Doerr, Lisa Tobin is our executive producer, Samantha Hennig is our editorial director, our technical manager is Brad Fisher,
sentences.zh: 拉里萨·安德森（Larissa Anderson）和温迪·多尔（Wendy Doerr）提供了编辑帮助，丽莎·托宾（Lisa Tobin）是我们的执行制片人，萨曼莎·亨尼格（Samantha Hennig）是我们的主编，我们的技术经理是布拉德·费舍尔（Brad Fisher），

sentences.en: our engineer is Chris Wood, and our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的工程师是克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood），主题音乐由沃德利的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰斯伯格（Ben Landsberg）创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Sam Dolan, Michaela Bouchard, Stella Tan, Pry Saif, and Una Osato.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢萨姆·多兰（Sam Dolan）、米凯拉·布夏尔（Michaela Bouchard）、斯特拉·谭（Stella Tan）、普赖·赛夫（Pry Saif）和乌娜·奥萨托（Una Osato）。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线切割机秀》（The Wirecutter Show）中，我们正在为节假日的招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会断片来睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在纽约时报应用程序或您喜欢收听的任何地方查找《电线切割机秀》。
